instruction: Query the OQMD database for the first SiO2 entry (element_set=Si,O AND ntypes=2), extract its name/composition/delta_e/stability/spacegroup, and save to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_4.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
